# telnyx_available_phone_numbers (Data Source)

Phone numbers available to order, found by the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Up to 10 local US numbers with SMS that start with +1312.
data "telnyx_available_phone_numbers" "chicago" {
  filter_country_code             = "US"
  filter_phone_number_type        = "local"
  filter_phone_number_starts_with = "312"
  filter_features                 = ["sms"]
  max_items                       = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_administrative_area` (String) Find numbers in a particular US state or CA province.
- `filter_best_effort` (Boolean) Filter to determine if best effort results should be included. Only available in USA/CANADA.
- `filter_country_code` (String) Filter phone numbers by country.
- `filter_exclude_held_numbers` (Boolean) Filter to exclude phone numbers that are currently on hold/reserved for your account.
- `filter_features` (List of String) Filter phone numbers with specific features.
- `filter_limit` (Number) Limits the number of results.
- `filter_locality` (String) Filter phone numbers by city.
- `filter_national_destination_code` (String) Filter by the national destination code of the number.
- `filter_phone_number_contains` (String) Filter numbers containing a pattern (excludes NDC if used with `national_destination_code` filter).
- `filter_phone_number_ends_with` (String) Filter numbers ending with a pattern (excludes NDC if used with `national_destination_code` filter).
- `filter_phone_number_starts_with` (String) Filter numbers starting with a pattern (excludes NDC if used with `national_destination_code` filter).
- `filter_phone_number_type` (String) Filter phone numbers by number type. One of `local`, `mobile`, `national`, `shared_cost`, `toll_free`.
- `filter_quickship` (Boolean) Filter to exclude phone numbers that need additional time after to purchase to activate. Only applicable for +1 toll_free numbers.
- `filter_rate_center` (String) Filter phone numbers by rate center. This filter is only applicable to USA and Canada numbers.
- `filter_reservable` (Boolean) Filter to ensure only numbers that can be reserved are included in the results.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `available_phone_numbers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--available_phone_numbers))
